digest.component_or_area: overlap judge / plan review advisory classifier
propositions: Batched overlap judge constructs RunRequest without operation-local output, structured-retry, transport-retry, or timeout bounds, inheriting generic 16K-token / 600-second policy that permits three generations before abstention
Malformed candidate_id responses triggered three 16K-token generations and multi-minute request windows, violating documented bounded-advisory intent from story 9022 and ADR 0086
Token-only or schema-validation-only limits prove insufficient; three structured retries still occur despite output cap, and malformed payload validation occurs only after bytes exist

Repair extends RunRequest with lowering-only per-request seams for structured retries, transport attempts, and timeout, applied in runner._effective_config before model construction and in both structured-output paths

Overlap judge must declare explicit advisory budgets: 1,024 output tokens, one structured attempt, one transport attempt, and 60-second timeout, with timeout/truncation/malformed output each returning exact all-candidate abstention
Valid batched verdicts retain label-keyed mapping and aggregation behavior; existing callers omitting request-local limits preserve current settings
